title: Andaman Creole Hindi - Wikipedia
text: Andaman Creole Hindi is a trade language of the Andaman Islands, spoken as a native language especially in Port Blair and villages to the south. Singh (1994) describes it as a creolization of Hindi, Bengali and Tamil.

title: Andaman Hindi Creole | World Mission Media
text: Andaman Hindi Creole, a Hindi-based creole, has roots in Hindi, Urdu, and other Indian languages. It evolved among the Indian convict population in the Andaman Islands during British colonial rule.
